en: Dependent on a state not acquired by clinging that is wholesome, there arises a state not acquired by clinging that is neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome by way of root condition. [Under] root condition: one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a state not acquired by clinging that is unwholesome, there arises a state not acquired by clinging that is neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome by way of root condition. [Under] root condition: one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition: one. (The indeterminate root is only one according to the mode of condition.
The Great Intermediate Dyad is finished.
